executive_summary: Money eliminates barter friction by acting as a universal medium of exchange. Commercial banks intermediate between depositors and borrowers, while credit can yield virtuous growth or vicious debt traps.

hotspots.popover_content: Money eliminates double coincidence of wants. RBI authorizes legal tender in India.

key_takeaways: Banks keep 15% cash reserve and lend 85% as credit.
Credit can be virtuous (Salim) or lead to debt traps (Swapna).
Formal credit requires collateral; informal credit charges exorbitant rates.
SHGs empower poor women by providing collateral-free bank loans.
